description: Tagging every model call with its cost owner (team, feature, agent) and recording the actual usage, so spend can be split, compared and limited.
Showing each team its AI spend (showback) or charging it to the team's own budget (chargeback).
Cost per unit of value, such as per resolved ticket or per active user; the number that decides whether a feature is viable.
An alert threshold (for example 80% of a budget) that warns the owner once while there is still time to act.
A refusal before the call when the worst-case cost would exceed a budget.
A cap on requests per time window per team or agent, which stops bursts and retry storms faster than budgets can.
